value.body: Education as a B.A. subject studies how people learn and how education systems work — the philosophy, psychology and sociology of education, child development, educational policy, and basic research methods. It is an academic subject, not a teacher-training course.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Education is offered as a major or one of the subjects in a B.A. at many state and central universities, through CUET-UG or Class 12 marks.

value.title: At a glance
items: It pairs naturally with a later B.Ed, which is the actual licence route to school teaching.
The four-year integrated ITEP is a separate route that combines a degree with a B.Ed from the start.
Graduate jobs without a B.Ed are mainly in tutoring, preschools, ed-tech and education NGOs.
College teaching of Education needs a Master's plus UGC-NET or a Ph.D.

value.title: Postgraduate students in Education
value.note: PG level in the subject Education, which includes M.Ed. as well as M.A. Education; UG figures for the B.A. major are not reported separately. AISHE counts responding institutions only; coverage varies by year.
